summary: The document outlines the business case, high‑level functional requirements and a basic set of non‑functional expectations for NovaCart, an e‑commerce storefront for Northfield Retail Group. It defines core journeys (registration, search, cart, checkout, order tracking), captures several business rules, and lists a handful of performance, availability and security goals. However, detailed technical specifications, compliance mappings (PCI‑DSS, GDPR/CCPA), concurrency handling, and measurable latency targets are missing.

risk_factors.title: Insufficient PCI‑DSS Detail
risk_factors.description: The document only states that no cardholder data may be stored locally and that a PCI‑compliant gateway will be used, but it lacks requirements for tokenization, encryption of data in transit and at rest, secure key management, and regular PCI‑DSS validation.
risk_factors.mitigation: Add explicit PCI‑DSS controls: use tokenization for card numbers, enforce TLS 1.2+ for all communications, encrypt any stored PAN fragments, implement strict access controls, and schedule quarterly PCI‑DSS compliance assessments.

verification.claim: Risk: Insufficient PCI‑DSS Detail — The document only states that no cardholder data may be stored locally and that a PCI‑compliant gateway will be used, but it lacks requirements for tokenization, encryption of data in transit and at rest, secure key management, and regular PCI‑DSS validation.
verification.reason: Grounding verified: matched 25 source keywords in document context.

risk_factors.title: Potential Cart Inconsistency Due to Infrequent Stock Sync
risk_factors.description: Stock data is refreshed only twice daily via batch API, while the cart must prevent adding out‑of‑stock items. This can lead to customers adding items that are no longer available, violating BRULE‑03.
risk_factors.mitigation: Introduce real‑time inventory checks via a low‑latency API or event‑driven stock updates, and implement optimistic concurrency control with reservation tokens for cart items.

verification.claim: Risk: Potential Cart Inconsistency Due to Infrequent Stock Sync — Stock data is refreshed only twice daily via batch API, while the cart must prevent adding out‑of‑stock items. This can lead to customers adding items that are no longer available, violating BRULE‑03.
verification.reason: Grounding verified: matched 25 source keywords in document context.

risk_factors.title: Missing GDPR/CCPA Data‑Privacy Controls
risk_factors.description: The document does not address lawful basis for processing personal data, consent collection, right‑to‑be‑forgotten, data minimisation, or data‑subject access request handling.
risk_factors.mitigation: Define privacy impact assessment, include consent mechanisms for marketing communications, implement data‑subject request workflows, and ensure PII is encrypted at rest with retention policies aligned to GDPR/CCPA.

verification.claim: Risk: Missing GDPR/CCPA Data‑Privacy Controls — The document does not address lawful basis for processing personal data, consent collection, right‑to‑be‑forgotten, data minimisation, or data‑subject access request handling.

risk_factors.mitigation: Add precise performance targets (e.g., P95 checkout latency ≤ 300 ms) and outline load‑testing strategy to verify under peak traffic.
